subject: Hearthwell - 3yr protection & uplift cap — committee review
messages:
From: Maria Torres <maria.torres@hearthwell.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Terms inquiry — 3yr commitment / price protection

Aditya / Lauren,

Thanks for the conversation this morning. Hearthwell is prepared to move forward on a 3-year commitment if we can get two protections built into the agreement: (1) an annual uplift cap of 5% (to protect against large step-ups), and (2) a renewal-protection clause that guarantees rate parity for first renewal unless materially changed usage occurs.

I've attached our RFP and a short summary of anticipated volumes. Can you confirm whether Redwood can agree to the uplift cap + renewal protection? We care about predictable unit economics for budgeting.

—Maria Torres
VP, Product Operations
Hearthwell Health
Attachment: Hearthwell_RFP_202612.pdf (pdf)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Maria Torres <maria.torres@hearthwell.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Terms inquiry — 3yr commitment / price protection

Hi Maria — appreciate the clarity and the attachment.

Short answer: Hearthwell's asks are reasonable commercially, but they are outside our standard auto-renew language and discount tiers; will need deal desk sign-off for the uplift cap + explicit renewal parity. Lauren / Jordan — looping you both.

I've included a proposed term sheet (v2) that preserves our margin floor while honoring a 5% annual uplift cap and an explicit renewal-protection paragraph tied to a usage delta threshold (see section 4). Can you review and advise next steps?

Next steps I propose:
- Lauren: internal escalation to deal desk for committee approval
- Jordan: quick finance review of margin impact (I attached a short volume/price sketch)
- Kimberly (deal desk/legal): confirm whether legal needs to change standard language

Maria — if we get committee OK today/tomorrow we can issue a DocuSign and aim to go-live Q1.

Thanks,
Aditya
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed_term_sheet_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Terms inquiry — committee review request (Hearthwell)

Kimberly / Jordan — forwarding Hearthwell's ask and Aditya's proposed term sheet. Key items for committee: 3-year commitment, 5% annual uplift cap, and renewal-protection clause that locks parity on first renewal unless usage changes >20%.

I ran a quick sensitivity in the attached pricing_summary_3yr.xlsx — at projected volumes this reduces expected revenue by ~7% over three years relative to our list escalation profile, but the ARR certainty is valuable and this is a strategic account for the health vertical.

Please advise: can deal desk approve a conditional exception to standard auto-renew and uplift rules? If legal needs to redline wording we should include a short clause that limits the renewal protection to the first renewal only.

High-level ask for committee:
- Approve 5% uplift cap (annually) for 3 years
- Approve renewal-protection for first renewal only, contingent on usage variance <= 20%
- Authorize Aditya to sign and send final DocuSign if legal sign-off is obtained

Thanks — can we get a decision by EOD tomorrow?

—Lauren
Head of Sales — Enterprise Accounts, Redwood Inference
Attachment: pricing_summary_3yr.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <lauren_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Terms inquiry — committee review request (Hearthwell)

Lauren — thanks for the materials and the sensitivity table.

Summary of my read: commercial concession is material but defensible given strategic fit. Conditions and recommended redlines below. I've attached a tracked redline to the proposed contract. Key points:
- APPROVE uplift cap of 5% annually for the 3-year term, provided we add an explicit "market adjustment" carve-out for any externally mandated pricing changes (e.g., regulatory costs)
- Renewal protection: APPROVE for the first renewal only, with a usage-variance cap of 20% as proposed; require renewal to be evaluated against an agreed usage baseline (appendix A)
- Require a 60-day notice window for changes at renewal and an escape clause for sustained overages >30% that allow price renegotiation

Legal redlines are in legal_redline_contract_v3.pdf — I suggest we get final legal sign-off on the renewal language before sending to Hearthwell. Once legal signs, Jordan / finance to confirm no accounting/ASC issues (revenue recognition) with how the renewal clause is written.

Conditional approval from Deal Desk: approved pending legal redline acceptance and finance confirmation.

Kimberly Park
Head, Deal Desk — Redwood Inference
Attachment: legal_redline_contract_v3.pdf (pdf)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2026 15:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Terms inquiry — committee review request (Hearthwell)

Kimberly / Lauren — finance review complete. Quick notes:
- Net present value impact looks acceptable with the uplift cap under the volume assumptions in pricing_summary_3yr.xlsx.
- No immediate ASC/recognition blockers flagged, but accounting wants the renewal-protection wording to explicitly call out how renewals are treated for revenue deferral (we can include a short accounting paragraph in the SOW).

Given Kimberly's conditional approval and accounting note, I'm authorizing the deal desk committee approval for this exception. Please proceed with final legal sign-off and issuance of DocuSign.

Approved by: Jordan Blake (on behalf of Deal Desk Committee)
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference

(Internal approval note: committee file DL-2026-0938 will be stored in HubSpot and archived in the deal desk folder.)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Maria Torres <maria.torres@hearthwell.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2026 17:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Approved: Hearthwell 3yr — uplift cap & renewal protection (next steps)

Maria — good news: Redwood's Deal Desk Committee has given conditional approval for the 3-year commitment with the 5% annual uplift cap and the first-renewal protection (usage variance <= 20%), subject to final legal wording. Jordan has cleared finance and Kimberly has submitted the tracked redline.

Next steps:
1) Legal to finalize the renewal paragraph (we've attached the redline).
2) I will issue a DocuSign (contract_final_docusign.pdf) for Hearthwell once legal confirms.
3) Aditya will coordinate implementation timelines and onboarding after countersignature.

Expected timeline: legal sign-off within 24 hours; DocuSign out by end of day Thursday if that holds.

Thanks for your patience — excited to get Hearthwell across the line.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales — Enterprise Accounts, Redwood Inference
Attachment: contract_final_docusign.pdf (pdf)
